verdict.rationale: The evidence offers no dedicated path or journey exploration feature. It shows only adjacent capabilities: building funnels of predefined steps, focusing session replays on specific flows, and jumping from a funnel to the exact session. Together these approximate seeing what users do around a key event only through manual, per-session review. Missing for 10: a documented path/journey analysis chart showing aggregated paths before or after a chosen event, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
